description: This file defines the AccountService class which manages user account operations such as registration, login, verification, password reset, and invitation handling within a multi-platform environment (open-source, cloud, enterprise). It interacts with various services and entities related to users, organizations, workspaces, roles, and sessions.

classes.name: AccountService
classes.description: Service class handling user account operations including registration, login, verification, password management, and invitations, with support for multiple platforms and integration with various related services and entities.

methods.name: resendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Resends a verification email to a user based on email, generating a new token and expiry.

methods.name: ensureOneOrganizationOnly
methods.description: Ensures that only one organization exists for the platform.

methods.name: createRegisterAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account registration process based on platform type, setting up user, organization, workspace, and roles accordingly.

methods.name: saveRegisterAccount
methods.description: Saves a newly registered account, handling database transactions and entity persistence.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Public method to register a new account.

methods.name: saveInviteAccount
methods.description: Handles inviting a user to an account, including sending invite emails and managing related entities.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Public method to invite a user to an account.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user, manages session, and records login activity.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a user's account using a temporary token.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by generating a token and sending email.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets user password after validating token and expiry.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user and records activity if platform is enterprise.
